description: This file provides an implementation of RSA cryptographic functions utilizing mbedtls within the libwebsockets project. It includes functions for key generation, encryption, decryption, signature signing and verification, and ASN.1 rendering of RSA public keys.

methods.name: void lws_genrsa_destroy_elements(struct lws_gencrypto_keyelem * el)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for each key element within an RSA key structure.

methods.name: int lws_genrsa_create(struct lws_genrsa_ctx * ctx,const struct lws_gencrypto_keyelem * el,struct lws_context * context,enum enum_genrsa_mode mode,enum lws_genhash_types oaep_hashid)
methods.description: Initializes an RSA context with key elements, setting parameters for key operation modes and padding.

methods.name: int lws_genrsa_new_keypair(struct lws_context * context,struct lws_genrsa_ctx * ctx,enum enum_genrsa_mode mode,struct lws_gencrypto_keyelem * el,int bits)
methods.description: Generates a new RSA keypair of specified bit size and extracts key components into provided key elements.

methods.name: int lws_genrsa_public_decrypt(struct lws_genrsa_ctx * ctx,const uint8_t * in,size_t in_len,uint8_t * out,size_t out_max)
methods.description: Performs RSA decryption using the public key, suitable for signature verification.

methods.name: int lws_genrsa_private_decrypt(struct lws_genrsa_ctx * ctx,const uint8_t * in,size_t in_len,uint8_t * out,size_t out_max)
methods.description: Performs RSA decryption using the private key.

methods.name: int lws_genrsa_public_encrypt(struct lws_genrsa_ctx * ctx,const uint8_t * in,size_t in_len,uint8_t * out)
methods.description: Performs RSA encryption with the public key.

methods.name: int lws_genrsa_private_encrypt(struct lws_genrsa_ctx * ctx,const uint8_t * in,size_t in_len,uint8_t * out)
methods.description: Performs RSA encryption with the private key.

methods.name: int lws_genrsa_hash_sig_verify(struct lws_genrsa_ctx * ctx,const uint8_t * in,enum lws_genhash_types hash_type,const uint8_t * sig,size_t sig_len)
methods.description: Verifies a signature against given data using specific hash type.

methods.name: int lws_genrsa_hash_sign(struct lws_genrsa_ctx * ctx,const uint8_t * in,enum lws_genhash_types hash_type,uint8_t * sig,size_t sig_len)
methods.description: Signs data hash using RSA private key and specified hash type.

methods.name: int lws_genrsa_render_pkey_asn1(struct lws_genrsa_ctx * ctx,int _private,uint8_t * pkey_asn1,size_t pkey_asn1_len)
methods.description: Builds ASN.1 DER-encoded representation of RSA public/private key.

methods.name: void lws_genrsa_destroy(struct lws_genrsa_ctx * ctx)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an RSA context.
